Not every holiday needs a new discovery. Sometimes, it needs a place that feels familiar from the moment you arrive.

01
THE HOUSE

Come for the coast.
Stay for the feeling.

Walk up the steps, through the balcao and into the lounge. The character of Palacete Rodrigues is in the things you notice slowly: carved furniture, chandeliers, patterned fabrics and the quiet presence of an old Goan home.

Necila Fernandes hosts this heritage holiday home in Mazal Vaddo, Anjuna. Outside, there are beaches to explore and market days to discover. Inside, there is a different pace.

“A home away from home.”THE HOUSE’S OWN MOTTO

An afternoon with nothing to prove.

03 / OUTSIDE THE FRONT DOOR

A day in Anjuna.
No fixed itinerary.

Begin with sea air at Anjuna Beach. Leave room for a market wander. Follow the North Goa coast when curiosity calls.

Return to Mazal Vaddo, to the house, the pool and the pleasure of having nowhere else to be.
